summary: Forget refused reconciliation context fingerprints before the next evaluation

schema.detail: No DDL, index, migration or storage-format change.

rules.detail: Admission, canonical ordering, checkpoint and effect authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: After an oversized or unencodable context is refused, a later encodable context is compared afresh even if it matches an older fingerprint; after that evaluation unchanged context can skip normally.

downtime.detail: No added downtime; no deployment is implied.

recovery.detail: Refusal removes only its retained digest and keeps the existing dirty/fallback and context byte/count limits. An evaluation that succeeds against refused input cannot cause an older digest to skip the next changed evaluation. Unrelated readers remain clean; no new queue, timer or writer work.
